query: INSERT INTO ingestion_state (key, last_epoch, last_block, last_id, updated_at) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, NOW()) ON CONFLICT (key) DO UPDATE SET last_epoch = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.last_epoch, ingestion_state.last_epoch), last_block = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.last_block, ingestion_state.last_block), last_id = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.last_id, ingestion_state.last_id), updated_at = NOW()
